orders.text:
WPPIL No. 201 of 2019
Hon’ble Ravi Malimath, A.C.J.
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Ms. Abhilasha Belwal, learned counsel 
for the petitioners.
Shri Pradeep Joshi, learned additional 
chief standing counsel for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
The learned advocate general 
submits that due to the unfortunate demise 
of the learned chief standing counsel, a new 
learned chief standing counsel is required to 
be appointed. Hence, at the request of 
learned advocate general, the matter is 
adjourned by four weeks.
Misc. application (IA No.10133 of 2020) 
is filed by the petitioners seeking for Police 
protection, in view of the fact that anti-social 
elements were against the removal of 
encroachment and are threatening the 
petitioners.
The learned additional chief standing 
counsel submits that an appropriate Police 
protection will be offered to the petitioners 
in order to protect their life, limb and liberty 
till the next date of listing.
His submission is placed on record.
Misc. application (IA No.10133 of 2020) 
is disposed off accordingly.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) (Ravi Malimath)
 18.11.2020 A.C.J.
 18.11.2020
S.K.
